title: Toolchain currency: @ruvector/router
command: test -n "$(bun info '@ruvector/router' version 2>/dev/null)" && test "$(bun info '@ruvector/router' version 2>/dev/null)" = "$(bun pm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '@ruvector/router@[0-9][^ ]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*@//')"
note: The current global installation matches the registry latest. The host's Bun global root is ephemeral under BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR, so this result should be re-probed after reboot.
